etsy.title: Christmas Gift Tags Printable, 60 Holiday Tags in 5 Styles, To From Labels, Instant Download PDF, Last Minute Present Wrapping
etsy.description:
Wrapping night, sorted. Print, cut, tie, done. 🎁

60 ready-to-print Christmas gift tags in 5 cheerful styles (Merry Christmas, Ho Ho Ho, Season's Greetings, Joy & Love, Let It Snow), each with a To / From line and a punch-hole mark.

WHAT'S INSIDE (7 pages)
• How to use page (paper, cutting, ink-saver tips)
• 5 tag sheets, 12 tags each = 60 tags
• 3 light ink-saver styles + 2 full-colour styles

INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped.
You get 2 PDFs: US Letter and A4. Print at home or at a print shop. For personal use only.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
